flavor:Adaptation Technology: Whoever lives in the desert learns to get by with less.
flavor:Adapted Lichen: It grows in the shadow of the rock, where the dew lies longest.
flavor:Advanced Ecosystems: Plankton, sandtrout, worm, spice – understand one link of the chain and you understand the planet.
flavor:Aerobraked Ammonia Asteroid: A Heighliner brings what the sand never had.
flavor:Ants: Even in the sand the small eat the smaller.
flavor:Aquifer Pumping: Pumps bring the pre-spice mass to light – before the worm does.
flavor:Algae: It takes root where the spice bloom loosened the sand.
flavor:ArchaeBacteria: Older than the worms – perhaps their ancestors.
flavor:Arctic Algae: Every blow whirls spores all the way to the pole.
flavor:Artificial Lake: One charge in the right place replaces a hundred years of patience.
flavor:Artificial Photosynthesis: Ixian light that feeds vegetation or catches dew.
flavor:Asteroid: It grinds rock to dust – and uncovers spice.
flavor:Asteroid Mining: Far from Arrakis the spice is refined – and becomes dearer.
flavor:Beam From A Thorium Asteroid: A ring of mirrors cools the air until it weeps.
flavor:Big Asteroid: Eight hundred kilometres per hour – nothing stays standing.
flavor:Biomass Combustors: Every blade contains water. You only have to press it out.
flavor:Birds: They circle over anyone dying of thirst in the desert.
flavor:Black Polar Dust: Dark dust melts the ice – the water wakes the sand.
flavor:Breathing Filters: A good suit loses barely a thimbleful of water a day.
flavor:Bushes: Tough, bitter and deep-rooted – like the Fremen.
flavor:Capital: Hastily built, expensively watered, well guarded.
flavor:Carbonate Processing: What evaporates here returns as dew.
flavor:Cloud Seeding: You steal the neighbour's cloud – and harvest the rain.
flavor:Colonizer Training Camp: Whoever trains here returns as a legend – or not at all.
flavor:Comet: The sand swells, then the spice bursts out in a fountain.
flavor:Convoy From Europa: Carryalls drop the harvester – a new field is opened.
flavor:Cupola City: Under the dome the air is humid – as long as the pumps run.
flavor:Decomposers: Nothing dead lies in the sand for long.
flavor:Deep Well Heating: Two kilometres deep – and then: a trickle.
flavor:Deimos Down: The carryall came too late. Of the harvester only plasteel scrap remains – and a track reaching to the horizon.
flavor:Designed Microorganisms: Bred in tanks whose contents nobody talks about.
flavor:Domed Crater: A crater with a roof – the first garden under glass.
flavor:Dust Seals: When the storm comes, they keep the sand out and the water in.
flavor:Ecological Zone: A fenced-in piece of the future.
flavor:Energy Saving: In every sietch every drop is counted.
flavor:Eos Chasma National Park: The chasm keeps out the wind – and holds on to life.
flavor:Equatorial Magnetizer: A shield over the equator impresses every envoy.
flavor:Extreme-Cold Fungus: It only grows in the cold of the desert night.
flavor:Farming: Where water flows, fields follow – and traders.
flavor:Fish: The Fremen send messages with them through the night.
flavor:Flooding: The storm came without warning – the neighbour's gear now lies under the sand.
flavor:Food Factory: Made of algae paste and spice – nourishing, not delicious.
flavor:Fusion Power: Whoever knows two springs will find the third.
flavor:Fueled Generators: The water sellers ring their bells in every alley.
flavor:Ganymede Colony: From here you see the storms before they come.
flavor:Geothermal Power: A rock cistern, sealed for generations.
flavor:GHG Factories: Boiling water makes the air heavy – just as it should be.
flavor:GHG Producing Bacteria: Tiny, countless – and it breathes out water.
flavor:Giant Ice Asteroid: You can see the fountain even beyond the horizon.
flavor:Giant Space Mirror: Water from space – paid for in spice.
flavor:Grass: Kynes planted it first on the lee side of the dunes.
flavor:Great Dam: Beneath the rock waits a lake only the Fremen know.
flavor:Greenhouses: In the caves of the sietches grows what would wither outside.
flavor:Heather: It blooms one week a year – and smells of cinnamon.
flavor:Heat Trappers: Condensers vanish at night – and turn up in the bazaar by morning.
flavor:Herbivores: Wherever the first green sprouts, they are already there.
flavor:Ice Asteroid: Two eruptions in one night – the harvest crews cheer.
flavor:Ice Cap Melting: The water soaks the pre-spice mass – and the sand bursts open.
flavor:Immigrant City: The villagers follow the water – and the tax collectors.
flavor:Immigration Shuttles: Everyone wants to see the planet the spice comes from.
flavor:Imported GHG: Imperial tanks full of mist – a gift with strings attached.
flavor:Imported Hydrogen: Crates full of life – and a drilling team as a bonus.
flavor:Imported Nitrogen: No nitrogen, no green – no green, no prestige.
flavor:Industrial Microbes: Plankton cleans the waste water – and hardens the plasteel.
flavor:Insects: They carry seeds from bush to bush.
flavor:Insulation: Whatever doesn't evaporate can be sold.
flavor:Ironworks: Its cooling water irrigates the gardens outside the gates.
flavor:Kelp Farming: Between the spice fields the first harvest sprouts.
flavor:Lake Marineris: A rift right across the erg – full of pre-spice mass.
flavor:Large Convoy: A whole Heighliner just for Arrakis.
flavor:Lava Flows: Water is trapped in the rock – it only has to be freed.
flavor:Lichen: At dawn it glitters – for one hour.
flavor:Livestock: Every creature needs water – every creature brings money.
flavor:Local Heat Trapping: A tarp, a stone, a night – and a full cup.
flavor:Lunar Beam: The Emperor gives water – and takes shares in return.
flavor:Magnetic Field Dome: Under the shield a garden defies the storm.
flavor:Magnetic Field Generators: A shield against the Coriolis storm over a whole region – no house has dared that yet.
flavor:Mangrove: At the edge of the spice field they root in the damp sand.
flavor:Martian Rails: Every sietch pays for messages faster than the storm.
flavor:Methane From Titan: Gas giants deliver what Arrakis lacks.
flavor:Micro-Mills: They turn in the night wind and gather every breath.
flavor:Mining Expedition: They take everything – even the fences.
flavor:Mining Rights: An imperial seal – and the rock is yours.
flavor:Mohole Area: Where the deep gives up its water, palm fronds soon rustle.
flavor:Moss: It soaks up the morning dew like a sponge.
flavor:Natural Preserve: Nobody digs here, nobody plants here. Here the worm rules.
flavor:Nitrite Reducing Bacteria: It fertilises the sand, grain by grain.
flavor:Nitrogen-Rich Asteroid: The first rain in millennia – the elders weep.
flavor:Nitrophilic Moss: It smells of cinnamon and grows where melange drifts.
flavor:Noctis City: Whoever resides in Arrakeen rules the planet – on paper.
flavor:Noctis Farming: Palms in the courtyard of the Residency – a provocation to every water carrier.
flavor:Nuclear Power: Family atomics are forbidden – family pumps are not.
flavor:Nuclear Zone: The Great Convention forbids atomics against people – not against rock.
flavor:Open City: A city without a dome – under an open, humid sky.
flavor:Optimal Aerobraking: A navigator sees the safest path – to profit as well.
flavor:Ore Processor: Washed spice – the waste water fertilises the gardens.
flavor:Permafrost Extraction: Ice from the pole dumped into the erg – the pre-spice mass awakens.
flavor:Pets: Every noble in Arrakeen keeps a tame desert mouse.
flavor:Phobos Space Haven: Only Guild shuttles land here – and whoever pays them.
flavor:Plantation: Measure, sow, wait – and measure again.
flavor:Power Grid: Open channels under rock – each new one feeds the next.
flavor:Power Plant: Whatever moisture the wind carries, the tribe catches.
flavor:Predators: The Old Man of the Desert takes what he wants.
flavor:Protected Valley: First a basin, then a valley, then a planet.
flavor:Rad-Chem Factory: Ixian chemistry – welcome in the Landsraad.
flavor:Regolith Eaters: It eats sand and leaves soil behind.
flavor:Release of Inert Gases: A breath for the planet – and applause in the Landsraad.
flavor:Research Outpost: Remote, inconspicuous – and full of plans for a green planet.
flavor:Rover Construction: Every new sietch needs crawlers to supply it.
Search For Life: Search for the Origin of the Worms
flavor:Search For Life: Where does Shai-Hulud come from? Whoever knows has earned three victory points.
flavor:Small Animals: The Fremen name their heroes after it – the mouse that survives in the desert.
flavor:Soil Factory: Sand, plankton, water – mixed into soil.
flavor:Solar Power: A thousand small condensers in a row.
flavor:Solar Wind Power: Caught in orbit, sold on Arrakis.
flavor:Soletta: They turn the light onto the poles – the ice melts, the air grows heavy.
flavor:Steelworks: Glowing plasteel, cooled with precious water.
flavor:Strip Mine: The rock is cleared – spice sleeps beneath it.
flavor:Subterranean Reservoir: A crack in the rock – and melange wells up.
flavor:Symbiotic Fungus: It feeds the plankton, the plankton feeds it.
flavor:Tectonic Stress Power: Tension in the rock squeezes water from its pores.
flavor:Towing A Comet: Behind the worm the sand is ploughed – spice seeps out, seeds sprout.
flavor:Trees: Where palms stand, no one will ever die of thirst again.
flavor:Tundra Farming: The first harvest ripens at the edge of the ice cap.
flavor:Underground City: Deep in the rock, where only Fremen find the entrance.
flavor:Underground Detonations: Every detonation opens a new moisture shaft.
flavor:Urbanized Area: Connected caves, shared water, common strength.
flavor:Water Import From Europa: Dropped from orbit where no carryall can reach.
flavor:Water Splitting Plant: One drop per vegetation – no more, no less.
flavor:Wave Power: Cool nights over the spice fields – and full basins in the morning.
flavor:Windmills: Once the air is humid enough, every trap pays off.
flavor:Worms: Where a sandtrout dies, a trace of water stays in the sand.
flavor:Zeppelins: Whoever flies doesn't have to cross the sand.
flavor:Acquired Company: One percent of CHOAM is worth more than a planet.
flavor:AI Central: Since the Butlerian Jihad, humans think – not machines.
flavor:Anti-Gravity Technology: Whatever floats need not be carried.
flavor:Asteroid Mining Consortium: The spice flows – only its direction changes.
flavor:Bribed Committee: Every vote has its price – in water or spice.
flavor:Building Industries: The press pounds day and night.
flavor:Business Contacts: Whoever knows the right people sees the market before anyone else.
flavor:Business Network: A trader in every alley, an informant in every trader.
flavor:Caretaker Contract: The council owes you water – and recognition.
flavor:Cartel: The closer to the throne, the fuller the coffers.
flavor:CEO's Favorite Project: The Baron has wishes. They are fulfilled.
flavor:Commercial District: Here you buy water, spice and rumours.
flavor:Corporate Stronghold: Black walls, red banners, nobody feels welcome.
flavor:Development Center: Beneath the surface of Ix, everything is being built.
flavor:Earth Catapult: With an imperial seal everything travels cheaper.
flavor:Earth Office: An envoy opens doors that otherwise stay shut.
flavor:Electro Catapult: Freight to orbit – without Guild toll.
flavor:Energy Tapping: On Arrakis stealing water is worse than murder.
flavor:Fuel Factory: No thopter flies without fuel – and no fuel without spice.
flavor:Gene Repair: The diamond on their forehead vouches for loyalty – mostly.
flavor:Great Escarpment Consortium: Whoever owns the rock sets the price.
flavor:Hackers: He looked like the chamberlain. He wasn't.
flavor:Hired Raiders: Smugglers don't ask whose cargo it is.
flavor:Indentured Workers: Cheap labour – dearly paid for in reputation.
flavor:Industrial Center: Whatever the Harkonnen don't count changes hands here – in the shadow of the sietch.
flavor:Interstellar Colony Ship: A thousand families seek a new world – a green one.
flavor:Invention Contest: Only one invention wins – the others disappear.
flavor:Inventors' Guild: A new machine every week – just below the ban.
flavor:Investment Loan: CHOAM lends gladly. It never forgets.
flavor:Io Mining Industries: The Guild stores spice for centuries – and lends it with interest.
flavor:Lagrange Observatory: From above you can see every worm – and every smuggler.
flavor:Land Claim: A letter with an imperial seal – nothing more is needed.
flavor:Lightning Harvest: The Coriolis storm carries moisture – you only have to intercept it.
flavor:Mars University: Here you learn ecology – and silence.
flavor:Mass Converter: The physics that makes folding space possible also pumps water.
flavor:Media Archives: Every legend is written down – and used.
flavor:Media Group: They sow legends on foreign worlds – and reap followers.
flavor:Medical Lab: Where there is building, there are injuries – and treatment.
flavor:Mine: Ore from the Shield Wall, cast into plasteel.
Mineral Deposit: Ore Vein in the Shield Wall
flavor:Mineral Deposit: A storm has laid the rock face bare.
flavor:Mining Area: First the claim, then the yield.
flavor:Miranda Resort: Where the nobility relaxes, money flows.
flavor:Physics Complex: Every insight costs water – a lot of water.
flavor:Power Infrastructure: The price rises with every degree of heat.
flavor:Protected Habitats: Whoever attacks a sietch has all the Fremen against him.
flavor:Quantum Extractor: It draws water from layers nobody knew.
flavor:Rad-Suits: When every sietch wears suits, the tailor profits.
flavor:Restricted Area: Whoever enters does not come back – but information does.
flavor:Robotic Workforce: No thinking machines – just very diligent ones.
flavor:Sabotage: A formal feud under the rules of the Great Convention.
flavor:Satellites: The Fremen pay the Guild so nobody sees their gardens – and nobody forecasts the storms.
flavor:Security Fleet: Drilled on Salusa Secundus, feared throughout the Imperium.
flavor:Space Elevator: The tallest tower in the city does not belong to the Duke.
flavor:Space Station: Whoever parks in orbit pays lower landing fees.
flavor:Sponsors: Friends in the Landsraad are expensive – enemies more so.
flavor:Standard Technology: Proven blueprints – no Ixian has to reinvent them.
flavor:Tardigrades: That is what the Fremen call the worm's brood. It gathers wherever there is water.
flavor:Technology Demonstration: The audience marvels – the spies take notes.
flavor:Terraforming Ganymede: What succeeded on distant worlds will succeed here too.
flavor:Titanium Mine: A harvest cycle lasts until the worm comes.
flavor:Trans-Neptune Probe: Beyond the edge of the map – perhaps a second desert.
flavor:Tropical Resort: A pool for bathing – the greatest decadence on Arrakis.
flavor:Vesta Shipyard: On the Guild's planet the Heighliners are born.
flavor:Virus: It carries sand plankton across half a continent – and buries everything else.
flavor:Allied Bank: CHOAM only lends to those it can buy later.
flavor:Biosphere Support: Kynes hands out seeds – and asks for patience in return.
flavor:Aquifer Turbines: Where the blow tears the sand open, the traps catch the breath of the deep.
flavor:Mohole Excavation: Two kilometres of rock – and beneath it ore and ancient water.
flavor:Early Settlement: A crack in the rock, a dew trap, a few families – that is how every sietch begins.
flavor:Biofuels: Sand plankton binds moisture – and feeds whatever grows next.
flavor:Power Generation: A hundred traps in the wind – a basin full every night.
flavor:Self-Sufficient Settlement: It needs no trader – and still sells to everyone.
flavor:Mining Operations: A seal from Kaitain – and the rock is yours.
flavor:UNMI Contractor: He speaks for the Great Houses – and remembers who listens.
flavor:Dome Farming: Holtzman fields keep the sand out – and the prices up.
flavor:Business Empire: Whoever holds CHOAM shares holds a piece of the Imperium.
flavor:Donation: A gift from the Emperor is never free.
flavor:Nitrogen Shipment: A Heighliner full of fertiliser – and the Landsraad applauds.
flavor:Smelting Plant: The slag is full of minerals – the planters gladly collect it.
flavor:Supplier: Ix delivers windtraps – with plasteel thrown in.
flavor:Supply Drop: The carryall comes, drops its load and is gone before the worm notices.
flavor:Great Aquifer: Beneath the erg the pre-spice mass ferments – ready to erupt.
flavor:Biolab: Every sample is a new chapter in Kynes' book.
flavor:Martian Industries: Stillsuits, windtraps and thopter parts are made here.
flavor:Io Research Outpost: Ixian researchers pay in insight – and in spice.
flavor:Polar Industries: At the pole the pumps thaw water – and uncover spice along the way.
flavor:Society Support: The tribe shares every drop – even when it costs.
flavor:Galilean Mining: Foreign worlds pay any price – as long as the spice flows.
flavor:Huge Asteroid: The Guild steers an ice comet into the atmosphere – for the price of a duchy.
flavor:Metals Company: Whoever holds ore and spice at once dictates the prices.
flavor:Loan: The Guild bank never forgets a debt – ever.
flavor:Mohole: Generations have filled it, drop by drop.
flavor:Metal-Rich Asteroid: The freighter shattered on the Shield Wall – the looters were faster than the salvage crew.
flavor:Orbital Construction Yard: No Heighliner leaves orbit without spice on board.
flavor:Acquired Space Agency: A Guild agent changes sides – with his entire archive.
flavor:Research Network: A Mentat knows every field – and everyone who masters it.
flavor:Eccentric Sponsor: A count at court funds whatever amuses him.
flavor:Ecology Experts: They know the desert has rules – and when to break them.
flavor:Experimental Forest: Deep in a rock basin grows what no Harkonnen must ever see.
flavor:Applied Science: A Mentat leaves no library – only students.
flavor:Board of Directors: Every director has a vote – and a price.
flavor:Focused Organization: Nothing is wasted – everything is traded.
flavor:Industrial Complex: An order from Giedi Prime: Carthag shall make everything itself.
flavor:Main Belt Asteroids: The Guild catches rocks in orbit – and sells what is inside.
flavor:Nobel Prize: You don't wear Kynes' medal – you earn it again every day.
flavor:Preservation Program: The Landsraad protects Arrakis – and slows anyone who grows too fast.
flavor:Project Eden: A sietch, a garden, a blow – paradise in miniature.
flavor:Recession: When the spice falters, the Imperium trembles – and someone profits.
flavor:Soil Bacteria: Where the brood lives the sand loosens – and roots take hold.
flavor:Space Lanes: The Guild knows every route – and charges a toll on all of them.
flavor:Suitable Infrastructure: Whatever is built must stay standing in the sand.
flavor:Terraforming Deal: Every vote in the Landsraad has its exchange rate.
flavor:World Government Advisor: He serves the throne – and the throne serves the planet. Mostly.
flavor:Tharsis Republic: Rule through the loyalty of the desert
flavor:Mining Guild: Whatever can be harvested will be harvested
flavor:Inventrix: What nature cannot do, we breed
flavor:Ecoline: The dream of a green Arrakis
flavor:Beginner Corporation: No house, no master – only opportunities
flavor:Point Luna: Friends at court hear everything first
flavor:Robinson Industries: Soo-soo Sook! – water for anyone who pays
flavor:Palladin Shipping: We bring the water down from the sky
flavor:Sagitta Frontier Services: The little folk keep the planet running
flavor:EcoTec: Every grain of sand can live
flavor:Spire: In the shadow of the throne
flavor:Terraformer: The Landsraad listens to you now.
flavor:Mayor: Whoever leads three sietches speaks for the tribe.
flavor:Builder: Plasteel and rock – your signature on Arrakis.
flavor:Landlord: The land belongs to whoever holds it.
flavor:Scientist: The Bene Gesserit watch – and take notes.
